messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem — collecting owners + timelines for the action items we agreed on. Please reply with: owner | ETA (YYYY-MM-DD) | blockers. TL;DR items: 1) quota bump request for eu-west (INF-3421), 2) scheduler tuning (preemption/backoff) PR, 3) headroom runbook + capacity targets, 4) autoscaler graceful scale-down delay change, 5) doc on recurring incident patterns.

kenji: I'll take scheduler tuning. Owner: kenji | ETA: 2026-04-07 | Blockers: need perf results from staging runs (k8s job queue). I'll link the PR when it's ready — working branch is: feature/scheduler-tuning.

maria: I can own the quota request. Owner: maria | ETA: 2026-03-30 | Blockers: finance sign-off for reserved instances. Filed INF-3421 and pinged cloud-ops. Follow-up: I sent the quota form to cloud sales earlier today.

nick: Headroom runbook owner: nick | ETA: 2026-04-14 | Blockers: waiting on Spike data for 95th pct seq lengths. I'll draft the runbook and include the capacity calc (targeting ~20% buffer).

sean: Autoscaler delay change owner: sean | ETA: 2026-04-02 | Blockers: want canary on non-prod first. Proposed change: increase scale-down delay from 300s -> 600s and add stabilization window. Will open RFC and a small patch. Example patch to test in staging:
```
kubectl patch hpa gpu-hpa -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":600}}}}'
```

jasmin: I'll own the recurring-patterns doc. Owner: jasmin | ETA: 2026-04-09 | Blockers: none. I'll capture the three recurring triggers we saw (quota exhaustion, bursty batch jobs, scheduler mis-prioritization) and propose monitoring alerts and runbook playbooks.

incident-bot: Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-gpu-capacity.md (summary attached).

anya: Great — thanks all. Quick notes: maria, if finance will block past 3/30 escalate to me and I'll loop in product for temporary reserved commit. kenji, include before/after tail-latency graphs in the PR. nick, add an ops checklist for runbook so oncall can follow. sean, schedule the non-prod canary for 3/29. jasmin, add a section mapping alerts -> who to page.

marina: @maria fyi finance prefers a single line justification with cost delta. (short)

maria: noted, I'll add cost delta and expected monthly savings.

kenji: quick question — do we want to try a small quantization trial as part of headroom work or keep separate?

nick: let's keep quantization as an experimental subtask in the runbook (owner: research team). Not blocking headroom runbook delivery.

anya: Plan: I'll compile owners + ETAs into a follow-up Jira board and assign. If anyone needs help getting unblocked, ping me or @oncall. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when their item is accurate.

kenji: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

nick: :thumbsup:

sean: :thumbsup:

jasmin: :thumbsup:

anya: Closing note: we'll reconvene in the postmortem follow-up sync next Wed 11am PT. If any deadline slips >3 days update the ticket. Thanks!
